newsitem.title: RUSSIA: No personnel changes announced at Russian cabinet.
newsitem.headline: No personnel changes announced at Russian cabinet.

text.p: Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin ended a speech at a meeting of Russia's cabinet on Thursday without announcing any personnel changes.
Earlier President Boris Yeltsin told parliament he would announce changes to the government in a few days.

Yeltsin's chief-of-staff Anatoly Chubais is attending the cabinet meeting, but it was not clear whether he was there as Yeltsin's representative or because he was going to be appointed to the government.
Kremlin sources say Chubais could be appointed first deputy prime minister with a broad role supervising the economy and combatting economic crime and corruption.
But earlier on Thursday Chubais said Yeltsin had not yet decided whether to transfer him to the government.
Chernomyrdin spoke for about an hour and the session continued.
